about_the_game:
Allyon: Battlecry

Real-time arena combat with a voice-trained monster companion that actually understands you.

Tell your Allyon to "make a hole and push him into it" and watch them dig a pit, then blast bubbles to knock your opponent in. Say "let's play tag!" and they'll chase you around, laughing. Your Allyon understands your words, your strategies, even your jokes.

Core Features

• Train by talking AND showing - Use your mic for natural instructions, then demonstrate tactics in-game. Your Allyon learns from your explanations and  examples!

• Duo combat - You're an active fighter with your own abilities. Set up combos, draw enemy fire, and coordinate as a seamless team in fast, reactive battles.

• Living sandbox battlefield - Physics-driven, destructible arenas where creativity is a weapon. Topple pillars, dig trenches, ignite props—change the map to change the fight.

• A bond that remembers - Lessons, preferences, and victories persist. Your Allyon's personality grows through your shared journey, not preset programming.

• Claim gyms & async PvP - Defeat players to claim a gym, then design it your way. Challenge other players' recorded strategies at your own pace.

• Powered by advanced AI to make the monster trainer fantasy finally, truly real.

Coming Soon

We're building Allyon: Battlecry from the ground up to deliver the ultimate monster trainer fantasy. Development is progressing quickly, and we're excited to share more as we get closer to launch.

Requirements: Microphone required. English at launch; more languages planned.

If raising a monster that truly listens gets you grinning, add to your wishlist and be among the first to know when we're ready to unleash your Allyon.
